description: This Java interface defines a set of commands related to 'sudo' operations on 'things' within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It aggregates command methods, constants for resource types, and nested classes for JSON field definitions, serving as a contract for implementing sudo commands.

classes.name: SudoCommand
classes.description: Defines a contract for sudo-related commands on 'things', including constants, method signatures, and nested classes for JSON field definitions.

classes.name: SudoCommand.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains static definitions of JSON fields used in sudo commands, such as 'thingId' and 'selectedFields'.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JSON pointer as resource path is not required for sudo commands.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string for sudo commands ('thing-sudo').

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix string for sudo commands ('things.sudo.' concatenated with a qualifier).

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for the command.
